gates.evidence: Several complete clusters each contain three yellow/gold round discs in triangular arrangement.
Complete clusters repeat on the front torso and the magenta lap panels, beyond the single sleeve example.
Clusters lie on the magenta front and lap fabric and follow its folds.
The discs appear as flat textile motifs, separate from the necklace, belt, earrings and table objects.

claim_limit: Specific triple-disc robe variant only; exact weaving technique, fabric chemistry, actual rank and historical authenticity are not verified. No larger H01 compound qualification.
supplemental_observations: Both hands visibly meet the paper/table area; the background attendant holds an empty tray.
Paper appears as an open bifolium rather than the intended closed folded petition.
The loose cord trails toward the viewer instead of toward the waiting tray, weakening the intended directional story cue.
Sound, chronology, petition content and actual political purpose cannot be established.
